# Third Coast — playoff night demo

**Generated. Do not edit here.** Every file in this repository is
built and force-pushed by the `deploy-demo` workflow in the
private `thirdcoast_brackets` repo; any commit made directly here
is overwritten by the next deploy.

This is a demo, not the tournament system that runs an event. It
keeps its state in your browser tab and has no accounts or
authentication of any kind. Real events run on hardware at the
venue, on its own network.
